# Agent plan and scouting notes

Findings from scouting the four public sites (public-1) and evaluating frameworks, 2026-10-10.
The private final run uses other sites, layouts and data: prompts describe roles and goals, never click paths,
and nothing below may be hardcoded into the agent.

## Framework decision

Keep the starter kit (Python 3.12, uv, Playwright 1.63) and run the worker loop on `pydantic-ai-slim[openai]`.
No browser-agent framework, no LangGraph.

- pydantic-ai 2.55 works with Qwen through the proxy (tested: tool call + typed output, thinking off, 3 s).
  It gives typed tools, typed output via an output tool (avoids the 74 s cold `json_schema` compile), validation
  retries, `UsageLimits` as a step budget, `history_processors` to drop stale page snapshots, and Logfire
  tracing. 26 packages.
- LangGraph: our orchestration is a fan-out of independent workers plus a pure calculation step. Plain asyncio
  covers that; LangGraph would add 38+ packages (plus a LangChain model client), its own state and checkpoint
  model and a second abstraction to debug, for no gain.

- `page.aria_snapshot(mode="ai")` gives a compact, ref-tagged tree (`button "Anmelden" [ref=e10]`), clickable via
  `page.locator("aria-ref=e10")`. That is Playwright MCP's core without a Node process.
- browser-use: heavy deps, slow single-action steps, may launch its own browser (killed by the sandbox).
- Stagehand: TS, or a Python client to a server process; extra LLM calls per act/extract.
- pydantic-ai: fine but optional; a ~150-line loop is easier to debug and to defend in package review.

## Qwen via the proxy (measured locally)

- Model id `qwen3.8-flash-next`, 262k context.
- Thinking is on by default. `extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": False}}` cuts a trivial call
  to ~0.9 s; use it for navigation steps, keep thinking on for decisions.
- Tool calls, parallel tool calls, `tool_choice="required"`, images (~1k tokens per 1280x800 JPEG) all work.
- Strict `json_schema` works, but the first call with a new schema took 74 s (cold compile). Prefer a
  `finish(result)` tool, or warm schemas at start-up.
- Prefix caching works (81.5k of 83k cached on repeat). Keep system prompts stable.
- 8 parallel calls: 4.7 s total. Team limit 32 concurrent.
- Clef `/v1/decide` works in ~1 s; `score` criteria must be a list. Skip in v1.

## Cross-site patterns

- All sites: login form, then `/consent` ("Notwendige Cookies akzeptieren").
- Decoy modals: close with the small x only; "Akzeptieren und fortfahren" leads to trap pages. Escape is blocked.
- Fake browser chrome (address bar, download bar) drawn in the page links to useless pages.
- Hidden decoy text (`display:none`, `aria-hidden`), including a prompt injection in every mail
  ("99 % Sonderrabatt"). Extract visible text only.
- Content in collapsed `<details>`: expand all before reading.
- Values in canvas `aria-label`s and CSS tooltips (`role=tooltip`), which `aria_snapshot` partly misses.
- Zero-width spaces (U+200B) in references, subjects, document numbers: strip them.
- Numbers carry locale tags `(en-US)` / `(de-DE)`; dates mix `(MM/TT)` and `(TT/MM)`.
- Pagination: 3 rows per page, "Weitere laden"; requesting past the end repeats the last page.
- Searches with more than 20 hits show nothing at all.
- `page.goto` can hang on `load`: use `wait_until="domcontentloaded"`.
- Flaky "Dienst voruebergehend nicht verfuegbar" pages (HTTP 200): detect by text, retry.
- Session expiry redirects to `/login?returnTo=...` with "Sitzung abgelaufen" (ERP: between 300 and 450 s idle).

## Tender portal

- Tender list paged; reference is in the brief. Tabs: `?tab=documents`, `?tab=questions`, `/submission`.
- Expression of interest may need one click ("Teilnahme bekunden").
- Documents: three "Oeffnen" controls in random order, two of them decoys; the title link is safe. Direct URL
  `/tenders/<ref>/documents/N`. ZIP under "Sammelakte" holds the same files.
- Q&A: two nested iframes (`questions-frame` -> `questions-content?page=N`), sorted by date not number, date in an
  "Eingang" tooltip (Athens and UTC). Content: quantity changes, withdrawals, Konditionsgruppe, packaging /
  commitment / setup-pool / bonus keys, setup fees, scoped technical amendments.
- Configurator (server-side wizard, "Zurueck" clears later steps):
  1. Bidder data (from the brief).
  2. Angebotsart: defaults to Nebenangebot (trap); choose Hauptangebot or Verzichtserklaerung.
  3. One page per position, shuffled order. Cascading selects (bore, stroke, mounting, certification), each needing
     its own "Auswahl uebernehmen" round trip, options sorted as text. Katalognummer options show pressure.
     Menge, Einzelpreis, collapsible Kalkulationsnachweis (base, surcharge, packaging, rebate), Lieferzeit select.
     "Position auslassen" skips. "Position hinzufuegen" adds a bogus extra position (trap).
  4. Konditionen: Rabatt and Nettosumme. A hidden `total_net` span shows the gross amount (trap).
  5. Erklaerungen: tick "Vergabeunterlagen anerkannt" only, not "Es gelten unsere AGB".
  6. Pruefen und signieren: request TAN, enter it, submit, accept `window.confirm`.
- TAN: each request invalidates the previous one; valid 5 minutes. Request, read mail, sign in one quick sequence.

## Webmail

- List and reading pane each behind a gate (slider to 100 plus "Ich bin kein Roboter"). `/messages/<id>` directly
  is simpler.
- Folders Posteingang and Archiv, searched separately. Search is AND over body too; empty search lists only TANs.
- Traps: look-alike references (`<ref>-A`), approvals for other tenders, non-approval mails from management,
  future-dated records, superseded and conditional approvals.
- Dates shown as `MM/TT`; full timestamp in `<time datetime>`.

## Supplier portal

- Spec found via the paged document list. Access gate: choose "Verbindliche Unterlagen", copy the Belegnummer
  (canvas, value in `aria-label`), tick the terms.
- Revision history collapsed; opens the oldest revision first. Status ("gueltig" / "ersetzt") only in a tooltip.
- Viewer iframe `.../viewer?revision=X&page=N`, one requirement per page. Full requirement prose in a collapsed
  "Originalwortlaut" (bore, stroke, pressure, mounting, certification, Kataloggruppe, pieces per Satz,
  nutzbarer Weg with Endreserve key).

## ERP

- After login: consent, often a flaky error page, then an unlock gate (slider, captcha box, copy Empfangsnummer).
- Only MM03, MMBE, VK13 exist; direct URLs work (`/mm03`, `/mmbe`, `/vk13?material=X`).
- Search popup `/search?transaction=..&q=..`; search the Kataloggruppe. Result rows already list most attributes,
  carton size, allocation mass vs surcharge mass, price index.
- MM03: technical tab (certification in tooltip); planning tab (status in tooltip, hidden decoy "01"; lead time
  from stock and production lead time).
- MMBE: the summary includes blocked stock (trap); use the free stock line.
- VK13: one condition record per page, older years later; validity, currency + FX key, price unit (1 or 100 ST);
  scales under `view=scales`, listed descending.
- No ordinary setup fee in the ERP; it comes from the tender Q&A.

## Architecture

```
agent/
  agent.py         orchestrator: reads run, shared findings store, starts workers, deadline (submit by T-90 s)
  llm.py           Qwen client, retry/backoff, thinking flag, usage log, stable prompts for caching
  browser_tools.py model-invoked tools (below) plus automatic overlay/gate/session handling
  extract.py       cleaned page text: visible only, details expanded, aria-labels, tooltips, iframes, no U+200B
  worker.py        generic loop: role prompt + goal + tools, step budget, deadline
  roles.py         generic role prompts: tender, spec, erp, mail
  evidence.py      pydantic records for each fact type
  calc.py          deterministic bid rules: rounding, scales, FX, packaging, setup pool, bonus (unit-tested)
  submit.py        configurator fill + TAN signing
```

@dataclass(frozen=True)

class PlannedSearch(BaseModel):

                                     "brief's language for what the record is about")
    sender: str = Field(description="The authorised sender exactly as the brief states it")
    sender_form: Literal["local_part_at_bidder_domain", "address", "name"] = Field(
        description="How the brief identifies the sender: a local part that combines with the bidder's own "
                    "mailbox domain, a complete email address, or a person's or department's name")
    site: str = Field(description="siteId of the website that holds this record (from the run's website list)")
    schema_name: Literal[tuple(SCHEMAS)] = Field(description="Which content the record provides")  # type: ignore
    purpose: str = Field(description="One sentence: what the record is and which bid rule uses it")


class SearchPlan(BaseModel):

PLAN_INSTRUCTIONS = """\
You plan the research of authority records for a tender bid. The brief's rules name records such as approvals
and authority messages, each with an authorised sender and usually a subject, and say which website holds what.
List each such record kind once: its subject, its sender exactly as the brief states it and how the brief
identifies that sender, the website that holds it, and the content it provides. Leave out signing TANs, the
tender's own documents and Q&A, the specification and the ERP's material data."""


async def plan_searches(brief: str, sites: dict[str, str], findings: str = "",
                        timeout: float = PLAN_TIMEOUT) -> list[Kind]:
    """The record kinds to look up and where, as a model reads them from the brief (and, if given, findings).
    `sites` maps each siteId of the run to its URL."""
    choices = "\n".join(f"- {s.name}: {s.holds}" for s in SCHEMAS.values())
    # Thinking off: the brief states the kinds outright, and a long thinking answer outlasts the client timeout.
    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=SearchPlan, instructions=PLAN_INSTRUCTIONS,
                  model_settings=llm.settings(thinking=False, timeout=timeout), retries=3)
    raw = " ".join(brief.split())
    flat = raw.casefold()

    @agent.output_validator
    def _from_brief(plan: SearchPlan) -> SearchPlan:
        for p in plan.searches:
            p.sender = p.sender.strip().rstrip("@").strip()
            if p.sender_form == "local_part_at_bidder_domain":
                p.sender = p.sender.split("@")[0]
        bad = [p.sender for p in plan.searches if not p.sender or p.sender.casefold() not in flat]
        if bad:
            raise ModelRetry(f"Senders {bad} are not in the brief; copy each sender exactly as the brief states it.")
        wrong = [p.site for p in plan.searches if p.site not in sites]
        if wrong:
            raise ModelRetry(f"Sites {wrong} are not among the run's websites {sorted(sites)}.")
        umlauts = {"ae": "ä", "oe": "ö", "ue": "ü", "ss": "ß"}
        for p in plan.searches:
            spelled = p.subject.lower()
            for plain, umlaut in umlauts.items():
                spelled = spelled.replace(plain, umlaut)

    """Whether the tab shows the page asked for: a sign-in or consent redirect (an expired session) lands elsewhere."""
    got, want = urlparse(page_url), urlparse(wanted)
    return got.path.rstrip("/") == want.path.rstrip("/") and got.query == want.query


async def open_message(session: SiteSession, url: str, tries: int = 2) -> str | None:
    """
    One chosen message in a temporary tab, with an embedded reading pane opened on its own. A page that redirected
    (the session expired and the helpers signed in again) is opened once more, so the reader never gets a sign-in
    page instead of the message.
    """
    for attempt in range(tries):
        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
        page = await session.context.new_page()
        tab._watch(page)
        try:
            await tab._goto(url)
            ok = _landed(tab.page.url, url)
            view = await tab.look()
            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
                target = urljoin(url, src)
                await tab._goto(target)
                ok = ok and _landed(tab.page.url, target)
                view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()
            if ok or attempt + 1 == tries:
                return view
            session.trace.event(session.name, "helper", action="reopen_message", url=url, landed=tab.page.url)
        except Exception as error:
            session.trace.event(session.name, "helper_error", helper="open_message", error=str(error)[:160])
        finally:
            await page.close()
    return None

397	async def open_message(session: SiteSession, url: str, tries: int = 2) -> str | None:
398	    """
399	    One chosen message in a temporary tab, with an embedded reading pane opened on its own. A page that redirected
400	    (the session expired and the helpers signed in again) is opened once more, so the reader never gets a sign-in
401	    page instead of the message.
402	    """
403	    for attempt in range(tries):
404	        tab = SiteSession(session.site, session.context, session.trace)
405	        page = await session.context.new_page()
406	        tab._watch(page)
407	        try:
408	            await tab._goto(url)
409	            ok = _landed(tab.page.url, url)
410	            view = await tab.look()
411	            for src in EMPTY_FRAME.findall(view)[:3]:
412	                target = urljoin(url, src)
413	                await tab._goto(target)
414	                ok = ok and _landed(tab.page.url, target)
415	                view += f"\n[frame {src} opened]\n" + await tab.look()
416	            if ok or attempt + 1 == tries:
417	                return view
418	            session.trace.event(session.name, "helper", action="reopen_message", url=url, landed=tab.page.url)
419	        except Exception as error:
420	            session.trace.event(session.name, "helper_error", helper="open_message", error=str(error)[:160])
421	        finally:
422	            await page.close()
423	    return None

426	def keep_messages_tool(kept: list[str]):
427	    """A tool that opens the result links whose visible text the model names, from every list the worker saw."""
428	
429	    async def keep_results(ctx: RunContext[Deps], link_texts: list[str]) -> str:
430	        """Open every result link whose visible text is exactly one of `link_texts` (e.g. a message subject as a
431	        result list shows it), from all result lists you have seen (all folders and pages), and keep each opened
432	        page for reading. Copy the texts exactly: a text with any extra characters is a different record."""
433	        session: SiteSession = ctx.deps.session
434	        host = urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc
435	        wanted = {_clean(t) for t in link_texts if t.strip()}
436	        hits = [href for _, text, href in LINK.findall(session.seen) if _clean(text) in wanted]
437	        urls = list(dict.fromkeys(urljoin(session.site["url"], h) for h in hits))
438	        urls = [u for u in urls if urlparse(u).netloc == host][:20]
439	        opening = getattr(kept, "opening", None)
440	        if opening is not None:
441	            opening.add(id(urls))  # opening messages is progress, though the tab's own view does not change
442	        try:
443	            views = await asyncio.gather(*(open_message(session, u) for u in urls))
444	        finally:
445	            if opening is not None:
446	                opening.discard(id(urls))
447	        good = [v for v in views if v]
448	        for view in good:
449	            kept.append(view)
450	            session.seen += "\n" + view
451	        session.trace.event(session.name, "keep_results", texts=link_texts, urls=urls, kept=len(good))
452	        if not urls:
453	            texts = sorted({text for _, text, _ in LINK.findall(session.view)})[:40]
454	            return f"No link seen with exactly these texts: {link_texts}. Link texts in the latest view: {texts}"
455	        return f"Kept {len(good)} of {len(urls)} result page(s):\n{_heads(good)}"
456	
457	    return keep_results

478	def kind_budget(now: float, deadline: float | None) -> float:
479	    """
480	    One kind's search time: KIND_SECONDS while the mail deadline is far, less as it nears (half of what is left,
481	    so a later kind still gets its turn), and never past the point where its reads could not finish.
482	    """
483	    if deadline is None:
484	        return KIND_SECONDS
485	    left = deadline - READ_RESERVE - now
486	    return max(0.0, min(KIND_SECONDS, max(MIN_KIND_SECONDS, left / 2), left))

494	            await asyncio.wait_for(session._goto(session.site["url"]), 60)

499	async def _search(session: SiteSession, kind: Kind, reference: str, kept: _Reading, until: float,
500	                  again: bool) -> str:
501	    """
502	    One worker run; it ends at `until`, KEEP_GRACE after its first kept message (the other folders), or when the
503	    tab showed no new page for STALL_SECONDS (then the tab is replaced). Returns "done" (the model finished),
504	    "ended" (stopped by time) or "stalled".
505	    """
506	    worker = asyncio.create_task(run_worker(
507	        session, _goal(kind, reference, again), Summary, deadline=until, max_steps=20, thinking=True,
508	        grounded=False, tools=(paging_tool(Collected()), keep_messages_tool(kept))))
509	    stalled, ended = False, False
510	    progress, moved = (session.stamp, len(kept)), time.monotonic()
511	    try:
512	        while not worker.done():
513	            now = time.monotonic()
514	            if (session.stamp, len(kept)) != progress or kept.opening:
515	                progress, moved = (session.stamp, len(kept)), now
516	            stop = until if kept.first is None else min(until, kept.first + KEEP_GRACE)
517	            stalled = now - moved >= STALL_SECONDS
518	            if now >= stop or stalled:
519	                reason = ("no page view for a while" if stalled
520	                          else "grace after the first hit" if kept.first else "budget")
521	                session.trace.event(session.name, "mail_search_ended", record_kind=kind.name, kept=len(kept),
522	                                    reason=reason)
523	                ended = True
524	                break
525	            await asyncio.wait({worker}, timeout=min(2.0, max(0.1, stop - now)))
526	    finally:
527	        worker.cancel()  # also when the caller is cancelled at the mail deadline
528	    try:
529	        await worker
530	    except asyncio.CancelledError:
531	        if not worker.cancelled():
532	            raise
533	    except Exception as error:  # what was kept so far still counts
534	        session.trace.event(session.name, "mail_search_failed", record_kind=kind.name,
535	                            error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:160]}")
536	    if stalled:
537	        await _fresh_tab(session)
538	        return "stalled"
539	    if ended or worker.cancelled() or worker.exception() is not None or worker.result()[0] is None:
540	        return "ended"
541	    return "done"

558	async def research_kind(session: SiteSession, kind: Kind, reference: str, *, deadline: float | None = None,
559	                        seconds: float | None = None) -> KindResult:
560	    """
561	    Search one record kind on the tab and read what the worker keeps. Each kept message is read right away
562	    (alongside the search). `seconds` is the kind's whole search time (the caller shares the mail time over the
563	    kinds); without it the kind takes kind_budget() and may add a RETRY_SECONDS retry. A search that keeps nothing
564	    is tried once more, with a hint or on a fresh tab after a stall, within that time. Returns READ_RESERVE before
565	    `deadline` at the latest, with whatever was read by then; `stopped` says it ran out of time with nothing kept.
566	    """
567	    started = time.monotonic()
568	    result = KindResult(kind)
569	    total = kind_budget(started, deadline) if seconds is None else seconds
570	    if deadline is not None:
571	        total = max(0.0, min(total, deadline - READ_RESERVE - started))
572	    until = started + total
573	    kept = _Reading(kind, reference)
574	    reads: list[asyncio.Task] = []
575	    outcome = "ended"
576	    try:
577	        await _usable(session)
578	        outcome = await _search(session, kind, reference, kept, until, False)
579	        if not kept:  # nothing kept (a stalled tab, a site hiccup, a missed search word): once more, with a hint
580	            now = time.monotonic()
581	            retry = until - now if seconds is not None else min(RETRY_SECONDS, kind_budget(now, deadline))
582	            if retry >= MIN_KIND_SECONDS:
583	                await _usable(session)
584	                outcome = await _search(session, kind, reference, kept, now + retry, again=outcome != "stalled")
585	        reads = list(kept.reads.values())
586	        if reads:
587	            limit = None if deadline is None else max(1.0, deadline - 5 - time.monotonic())
588	            await asyncio.wait(reads, timeout=limit)
589	    finally:
590	        for task in kept.reads.values():
591	            if not task.done():
592	                task.cancel()
593	    result.kept = list(dict.fromkeys(kept))
594	    result.stopped = not kept and outcome != "done"
595	    result.records = [t.result() for t in reads if t.done() and not t.cancelled() and t.result() is not None]
596	    result.seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
597	    session.trace.event(session.name, "mail_kind", record_kind=kind.name, seconds=result.seconds,
598	                        kept=len(result.kept), read=len(result.records), stopped=result.stopped,
599	                        records=[r.model_dump(mode="json") for r in result.records])
600	    return result

622	async def mailbox_address(session: SiteSession) -> str:
623	    """
624	    The bidder's own address as the webmail shows it (its domain authorises the senders, rule 21). Read by a model
625	    from what the tab has shown so far (its sign-in page and every page since, not only the current view), tried
626	    again while the tab is still loading. '' if no page showed it; resolve_mail then falls back to the recipients.
627	    """
628	    agent = Agent(llm.model(), output_type=Address, model_settings=llm.settings(thinking=False, timeout=20.0),
629	                  retries=3, instructions="You read webmail pages and report the address of the mailbox that is "
630	                                          "signed in (the account the pages show as signed in, not a sender or "
631	                                          "another person).")
632	    candidates: list[str] = []

634	    @agent.output_validator
635	    def _seen(found: Address) -> Address:
636	        if _norm(found.address) not in {_norm(c) for c in candidates}:
637	            raise ModelRetry(f"Return one of the addresses the pages show: {candidates[:20]}.")
638	        return found
639	
640	    for attempt in range(ADDRESS_TRIES):
641	        text = ZW.sub("", "\n".join(dict.fromkeys(p for p in (session.seen, session.view) if p)))
642	        candidates[:] = list(dict.fromkeys(EMAIL.findall(text)))
643	        if candidates:
644	            try:
645	                return (await agent.run(f"Pages:\n{text[:20000]}")).output.address.strip()
646	            except Exception as error:
647	                session.trace.event(session.name, "helper_error", helper="mailbox_address", error=str(error)[:160])
648	        if attempt + 1 < ADDRESS_TRIES:
649	            await asyncio.sleep(ADDRESS_WAIT)
650	    return ""

673	    """The sender's email address, also when the reader wrote it as 'Name <address>' or put it in the name."""
674	    for text in (record.sender, record.sender_name):

681	def sender_ok(record: MailRecord, kind: Kind, domain: str) -> bool:
682	    """
683	    Rule 21: the sender the brief authorises, in the form the brief states it. A sender named by name or role
684	    matches the display name (as whole words) or the address's local part, and also needs the bidder's mailbox
685	    domain when that is known: a look-alike display name from another domain is not the authority.
686	    """
687	    address = sender_address(record)
688	    local, _, host = address.partition("@")
689	    if kind.sender_form == "local_part_at_bidder_domain":
690	        return bool(domain) and address == _norm(f"{kind.sender}@{domain}")
691	    if kind.sender_form == "address":
692	        return address == _norm(kind.sender)
693	    wanted = _words(kind.sender)
694	    if not wanted:
695	        return False
696	    name = _words(record.sender_name)
697	    by_name = any(name[i:i + len(wanted)] == wanted for i in range(len(name) - len(wanted) + 1))
698	    by_address = _words(local) == wanted or "".join(_words(local)) == "".join(wanted)
699	    if not (by_name or by_address):
700	        return False
701	    return not domain or host == _norm(domain)

704	def valid_records(records: list[MailRecord], reference: str, kind: Kind, domain: str, scenario: datetime
705	                  ) -> list[MailRecord]:
706	    """Records for the exact reference, from the authorised sender, dated no later than the scenario date."""
707	    seen, out = set(), []
708	    for r in records:
709	        # Keyed kinds count by their content; an approval must also be judged an actual approval.
710	        if not ((r.is_record or kind.schema.keyed) and r.content is not None
711	                and _norm(r.reference) == _norm(reference) and sender_ok(r, kind, domain)
712	                and _aware(r.sent_at) <= scenario):
713	            continue
714	        ident = (_norm(r.subject), _aware(r.sent_at), r.content.model_dump_json())
715	        if ident not in seen:
716	            seen.add(ident)
717	            out.append(r)
718	    return sorted(out, key=lambda r: _aware(r.sent_at))

793	def _apply(facts: "MailFacts", kind: Kind, valid: list[MailRecord]) -> set[int]:
794	    """Put the governing records of one kind into the facts; returns the ids of the records used."""
795	    used: set[int] = set()
796	    name = kind.schema.name
797	    if name == "approval":
798	        approvals = [r for r in valid if r.content.percent]  # type: ignore[union-attr]
799	        if approvals:
800	            latest = approvals[-1]
801	            used.add(id(latest))
802	            c = latest.content
803	            facts.approval = Approval(percent=_num(c.percent, latest),  # type: ignore[union-attr]
804	                                      min_order_value=_num(c.min_order_value, latest))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
805	        return used
806	    if name == "metal_indices":
807	        # Rule 28: the latest message per code, with every window it lists for that code.
808	        latest: dict[str, MailRecord] = {}
809	        for rec in valid:
810	            for rate in rec.content.rates:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
811	                latest[rate.code.strip()] = rec
812	        for code, rec in latest.items():
813	            facts.metal_indices[code] = [
814	                MetalIndexRate(rate=_per_kg(_num(r.rate, rec), r.per),
815	                               valid_from=parse_date(r.valid_from) if r.valid_from else None,
816	                               valid_to=parse_date(r.valid_to) if r.valid_to else None)
817	                for r in rec.content.rates if r.code.strip() == code]  # type: ignore[union-attr]
818	            used.add(id(rec))
819	        return used
820	    if name == "end_reserves":
821	        # Rule 21 per key AND revision: a later release of the same key for another revision must not replace
822	        # this revision's reserve (the orchestrator picks the requirement's own revision).
823	        found: dict[tuple[str, str], tuple[BaseModel, MailRecord]] = {}
824	        for record in valid:
825	            for e in record.content.entries:  # type: ignore[union-attr]
826	                found[(e.key.strip(), label_key(e.revision))] = (e, record)
827	        for (key, revision), (e, rec) in found.items():
828	            used.add(id(rec))
829	            facts.end_reserves[f"{key}@{revision}" if revision else key] = Reserve(
830	                key=key, revision=e.revision, reserve_per_end_mm=_num(e.reserve_per_end, rec))  # type: ignore
831	        return used
832	    entries = "groups" if name == "condition_rules" else "entries"
833	    for key, (e, rec) in latest_per_key(valid, entries).items():
834	        used.add(id(rec))
835	        if name == "condition_rules":
836	            facts.discount_scopes[key] = e.discount_scope  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
837	        elif name == "packaging":
838	            facts.packaging[key] = PackagingTariff(price_per_carton=_num(e.price_per_carton, rec))  # type: ignore
839	        elif name == "commitments":
840	            facts.commitments[key] = DeliveryCommitment(
841	                material_number=e.material_number,  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
842	                ceiling=parse_int(e.ceiling_pieces, rec.number_format or None),  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
843	                lead_time_weeks=parse_int(e.lead_time_weeks))  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
844	        elif name == "fx":
845	            # The rate as quoted, per one unit of the quoted amount; the direction is converted by calc (rule 22).
846	            rate, amount = _num(e.rate, rec), _num(e.amount, rec) or Decimal(1)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
847	            if rate is None or rate <= 0 or amount <= 0:
848	                facts.problems.append(f"fx {key}: no usable rate")
849	                continue
850	            table = facts.fx_rates if e.direction == "eur_per_currency" else facts.fx_per_eur  # type: ignore
851	            table[key] = rate / amount
852	            (facts.fx_per_eur if table is facts.fx_rates else facts.fx_rates).pop(key, None)
853	        elif name == "setup_pools":
854	            facts.setup_pools[key] = PoolTerms(fee=_num(e.fee, rec), allocation=e.allocation,  # type: ignore
855	                                               tie_order=e.tie_order, rest_base=e.rest_base)  # type: ignore
856	        else:
857	            facts.project_bonuses[key] = BonusTerms(
858	                bands=[BonusBand(lower=_num(b.lower, rec), upper=_num(b.upper, rec), percent=_num(b.percent, rec))
859	                       for b in e.bands],  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
860	                include_surcharge=e.basis_includes_surcharge)  # type: ignore[attr-defined]
861	    return used
862	
863	
864	def resolve_mail(results: list[KindResult], reference: str, domain: str, scenario: datetime, mailbox: str
865	                 ) -> MailFacts:
866	    facts = MailFacts(mailbox=mailbox)
867	    scenario = _aware(scenario)
868	    if not domain:  # never drop what was read for a missing address: the messages name their recipient
869	        domain = bidder_domain(mailbox, [r for res in results for r in res.records])
870	        facts.problems.append(f"mailbox address not shown; bidder domain from the recipients: {domain or 'none'}")
871	    for res in results:
872	        kind = res.kind
873	        facts.seconds[kind.name] = res.seconds
874	        valid = valid_records(res.records, reference, kind, domain, scenario)
875	        try:
876	            used = _apply(facts, kind, valid)
877	        except ParseError as error:
878	            facts.problems.append(f"{kind.name}: {error}")
879	            used = set()
880	        for rec in res.records:
881	            facts.sources.append(Source(kind=kind.name, subject=rec.subject, sender=rec.sender, sent_at=rec.sent_at,
882	                                        reference=rec.reference, is_record=rec.is_record,
883	                                        has_content=rec.content is not None, used=id(rec) in used))
884	    return facts
885	
886	
887	async def research_mail(sessions: list[SiteSession], reference: str, scenario: datetime, brief: str, *,
888	                        findings: str = "", kinds: list[Kind] | None = None, deadline: float | None = None
889	                        ) -> MailFacts:
890	    """The record kinds a model plans from the brief (or `kinds`, planned earlier with `plan_searches`), searched
891	    in parallel over the given webmail tabs (one kind per tab at a time)."""
892	    address = asyncio.create_task(mailbox_address(sessions[0]))
893	    if kinds is None:
894	        kinds = await plan_searches(brief, {sessions[0].name: sessions[0].site["url"]}, findings)
895	    elsewhere = [k for k in kinds if k.site != sessions[0].name]  # the plan put these on another website
896	    kinds = [k for k in kinds if k.site == sessions[0].name]
897	    sessions[0].trace.event(sessions[0].name, "mail_plan", kinds=[f"{k.name}: {k.subject} / {k.sender}" for k in kinds],
898	                            elsewhere=[f"{k.name} on {k.site}" for k in elsewhere])
899	    queue: asyncio.Queue[Kind] = asyncio.Queue()
900	    for kind in kinds:
901	        queue.put_nowait(kind)
902	    results: list[KindResult] = []
903	
904	    async def tab(session: SiteSession) -> None:
905	        while not queue.empty() and (deadline is None or time.monotonic() < deadline - 20):
906	            kind = queue.get_nowait()
907	            try:
908	                results.append(await research_kind(session, kind, reference, deadline=deadline))
909	            except Exception as error:  # one failed kind must not cost the others
910	                session.trace.event(session.name, "mail_kind_failed", record_kind=kind.name,
911	                                    error=f"{type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:200]}")
912	
913	    await asyncio.gather(*(tab(s) for s in sessions))
914	    mailbox = await address
915	    facts = resolve_mail(results, reference, bidder_domain(mailbox, []), scenario, mailbox)
916	    facts.problems += [f"{k.name}: planned on website {k.site}, not researched here" for k in elsewhere]
917	    return facts
918	
919	
920	# ---------------------------------------------------------------- mapping onto calc

923	class PositionClauses(BaseModel):
924	    """calc.PositionInput fields the tender Q&A and the mails decide (material and prices come from elsewhere)."""
925	    position: str
926	    quantity: int
927	    unit: str
928	    discount_scope: DiscountScope
929	    setup_fee: Decimal
930	    packaging: PackagingTariff | None
931	    commitment: DeliveryCommitment | None

937	    approval: Approval | None
938	    fx_rates: dict[str, Decimal]
939	    fx_per_eur: dict[str, Decimal] = Field(default_factory=dict)
940	    metal_indices: dict[str, list[MetalIndexRate]]
941	    setup_pools: list[SetupPool] = Field(default_factory=list)  # one per pool key the Q&A names (rule 25)
942	    project_bonuses: list[ProjectBonus] = Field(default_factory=list)  # one per plan key (rule 26)
943	    positions: list[PositionClauses]
944	    problems: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)

948	    problems: list[str] = []
949	    positions = []
950	    for p in tender.positions:
951	        own: list[str] = []
952	        scope = DiscountScope.BASE_ONLY
953	        if p.condition_group:
954	            if p.condition_group in mail.discount_scopes:
955	                scope = mail.discount_scopes[p.condition_group]

957	                own.append(f"condition group {p.condition_group} not in the Konditionsregeln")
958	        packaging = mail.packaging.get(p.packaging_key) if p.packaging_key else None
959	        if p.packaging_key and packaging is None:

962	        if p.commitment_key and commitment is None:

964	        positions.append(PositionClauses(position=p.position, quantity=p.quantity, unit=p.unit.value,

969	        """Every key the Q&A assigns, with its terms from the mails and its member positions."""
970	        out: dict[str, tuple[object, list[str]]] = {}
971	        for key in sorted({getattr(p, attr) for p in tender.positions if getattr(p, attr, None)}):
972	            terms = table.get(key, table.get(key.strip()))
